sn15.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
sn15.20:2.2: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.20:2.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa pācīnavaṃsotveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:2.4: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ tivarā tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:2.5: tivarānaṃ bhikkhave, manussānaṃ cattāḷīsa vassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:2.6: tivarā bhikkhave, manussā pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catuhena ārohanti, catuhena orohanti.
sn15.20:2.7: tena kho pana samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:2.8: kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhura-sañjīvaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:2.9: passatha bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā. te ca manussā kālakatā. so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
sn15.20:2.13: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccituṃ.
sn15.20:3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa vaṅkako tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:3.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ rohitassā tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:3.3: rohitassānaṃ bhikkhave, manussānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:3.4: rohitassā bhikkhave, manussā vaṅkakaṃ pabbataṃ tīhena ārohanti, tīhena orohanti.
sn15.20:3.5: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena koṇāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:3.6: koṇāgamanassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyo suttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:3.7: passatha bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā. te ca manussā kālakatā? so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
sn15.20:4.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa suphasso tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:4.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena manussānaṃ suppiya. tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:4.3: suppiyānaṃ bhikkhave, manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:4.4: suppiyā bhikkhave, manussā suphassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti dvīhena orohanti.
sn15.20:4.5: tena kho pana bhikkhave, samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:4.6: kassapassa bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tissa-bhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:4.7: passatha bhikkhave, sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kālakatā. so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
sn15.20:5.1: etarahi kho pana bhikkhave, imassa vepullassa pabbatassa vepullo tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:5.2: etarahi kho pana bhikkhave, imesaṃ manussānaṃ māgadhakā tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:5.3: māgadhakānaṃ bhikkhave, manussānaṃ appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahukaṃ.
sn15.20:5.4: yo ciraṃ jīvati, so vassasataṃ, appaṃ vā bhiyyo
sn15.20:5.5: māgadhakā bhikkhave, manussā vepullaṃ pabbataṃ muhuttena ārohanti, muhuttena orohanti.
sn15.20:5.6: etarahi kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave, arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
sn15.20:5.7: mayhaṃ kho pana bhikkhave, sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:5.8: bhavissati bhikkhave, so samayo yā ayañcevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antaradhāyissati. ime ve manussā kālaṃ karissanti. ahañca parinibbāyissāmi.
sn15.20:5.12: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitunti.
sn15.20:6.2: idaṃ vatvā sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā:
